newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trio of small quakes felt in NZ, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Trio of small quakes felt in NZ, no damage.

text.p: Three earthquakes jolted New Zealand's lower North and upper South Islands overnight but there were no reports of damage, seismologists said on Friday.
The biggest was a moderate quake of 5.6 on the Richter scale near the South Island spa town of Hanmer -- just 20 km (12 miles) from where a 5.5 tremor was recorded on August 29.
Small tremors measuring 3.5 and 3.7 were measured near the capital, Wellington, on Thursday evening.
New Zealand is part of a belt of earthquake around the Pacific Rim, and a quake of six or higher on Richter occurs on average once a year.
